  # "switch" to user
  def switch_to_user
    # check user
    if !params[:id]
      render(
        json:   { message: 'no user given' },
        status: :not_found
      )
      return false
    end

    user = User.find(params[:id])
    if !user
      render(
        json:   {},
        status: :not_found
      )
      return false
    end

    raise Exceptions::UnprocessableContent, __('User is inactive.') if !user.active

    session[:switched_from_user_id] ||= current_user.id
